notes.title: WarioWare-Like Minigame Collection SUPER 56 Receives Huge Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone 👋

Get ready to dive into the chaos with your friends as [b] couch multiplayer[/b] arrives to SUPER 56, turning your gaming sessions into crazy battles filled with laughter, competition, and... John Zombie?

📢 Check out the Multiplayer Announcement Trailer
[previewyoutube=X_V5tI5p5qQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Multiplayer features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 to 8 players for pass-the-controller play, 
[*] each rapid-fire minigame demands only one button press. 
[*] Adjust game rules like speed, stage types, and round counts to tailor your multiplayer experience
[*] Steam’s Remote Play Together supported
[/list]

[h3]Other updates [/h3]
Incase you missed it, SUPER 56 boasts a plethora of new content, including [b]Trials [/b]for added challenge,[b] gameplay improvements[/b], and the [b]innovative mic mode[/b], letting players control the game with their voice input. We've also updated the demo to reflect stage updates.

[b]📢Introducing Mic Mode:[/b]
[previewyoutube=EAhPmjWxjYM;full][/previewyoutube]

Ready to dive in? Grab your copy of SUPER 56 on Steam for just $6.99 and experience the ultimate party gaming sensation!

🔗 [b]Get SUPER 56 on Steam[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659150/SUPER_56/]Purchase Now![/url]

[h3]Full Game Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 56 fast-paced games full of references and humor
[*] A wide range of genres from karting to dating sims
[*] Simple one-button controls for accessibility
[*] New mic mode for voice control
[*] Daily Challenges and leaderboards for competitive play
[*] Local multiplayer for 2-8 players
[*] Fully customizable characters and achievements
[*] Dynamic soundtrack to match the game's tempo
[/list]

notes.title: SUPER 56 V1.22: SUPER NEW CONTENT UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hey HUMANS! It's time to check out the new features in our latest SUPER 56 update which is available now:

[h1]Mic Control (experimental)[/h1]

[previewyoutube=EAhPmjWxjYM;full][/previewyoutube]

Now you can control the whole game using your microphone input, we find this works best with a head-set style mic so that other sounds don't interfere with your game. We had a real fun time playing SUPER 56 using guitars, dog toys and other random items, it's a total blast!

[h1]Trial Mode - Clean the Whole House[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/de85e44a9feec6af5daff5ab635c7d4756d5cbf4.gif[/img]

We've added the first Trial to the game, in this trial you need to clean the whole house using the cat-vacuum. Each new trial we add will come with its own leaderboard too so please look forward to them. Yeah!

[h1]New Achievements[/h1]

There are two new achievements, both are unlocked via the new Clean the House Trial. One is secret and the other can be unlocked by completing the trial in under 4 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e5fb9e561af3567f53bfc4914a76c4834821ce09.jpg[/img]

There is also a new Achievements table, so you can see the full list of achievements you've unlocked, and need to unlock

[h1]Leaderboard Changes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/db7f0e42a22f2f690ddadd0d68386cd6318b2a9d.jpg[/img]
You'll now see everyone's amusing phrases on their leaderboard entries, I spend too much time looking at these.

[h1]Misc[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e67f78807dd010ac846015e305202d695e63ebaa.jpg[/img]

Various UI and localisation improvements (including fixing the Simplified Chinese credits).
We've also replaced the image of our dear Reiwa man with a delightful 3D model of someone who looks scarily similar, but is.definitely.not.him.... ok?


[h1]Future Development:[/h1]

We're currently splitting our time between adding new content and preparing the game for Nintendo Switch porting. We really hope that SUPER 56 will gain some much needed visibility by being available on Switch and if that is the case it will enable us to bring even more updates to the Steam version.

Thanks again for your continued support!

Andy & Amy

notes.title: V1.15 Bug fixes are here!
notes.notes:
- The statistic 'Times Played' for each stage is now being properly recorded and loaded (PRACTICE plays don't count but I will enable this is people request it)

That's all for today, more updates coming soon :)

notes.title: v1.14 Patch now live!
notes.notes:
Hi all.

Combined in this update are versions 1.13 and 1.14. Patch notes below:

V1.13 patch notes:

Achievements:
- Act Of Kindness achievement now works (unlocks if you have 300 coins or more)
- Players getting B5 achievement for the first time should now be given the correct achievement (instead of Time Lord)
- Players who are already at Rank B Level 6 prior to this update will be given B5 achievement automatically

Gameplay:
- Added an extra 5 seconds to the 'Pay Attention' game, now it should always display at least one 'PRESS' instruction

- On 'Bounce' the stop can now be skipped a maximum of 20 times to stop the player
from running out of time and failing and from gaining too many points on this stage

Sound:
- Sound mixer properly set in the following stages: Fuel the Car, Feed the Baby, Tennis,
Snake

localisation:
- Best player in world is now being pulled from loc sheet (awaiting translations to add into loc sheet)
- Stage score screen TOTAL and STAGE, Giftbag UI Back button, Giftbag duplicate label now properly localised
- RANK and HISCORE on new game config page is now localised when player is offline
- Game control tip at the bottom of the screen switching back to English now fixed

V1.14 patch notes:

- Mapped audio correctly on intro, skijump stage, golf stage, woof, only shoot bad guys, eat 20 apples, look at camera,
- Fixed the Eagle Eye Cherub achievement
- Made the GiftBag contents easier to see by changing the background
- Fixed: Sometimes after viewing Daily Challenge scores the next standard run would incorrectly save the score to the Daily Challenge leaderboard

More fixes to come, please leave any bug reports in the discussion forum

notes.title: SUPER 56 - Launch update and beta testing
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have some great news, we've agreed a deal with a publisher to bring SUPER 56 to Steam (and other platforms a little afterwards).

Our publisher will bring more languages support for SUPER 56, including German, Chinese, Japanese, and so forth.

While we initially viewed that the game should release into Early Access very soon we have come to an agreement that SUPER 56 will instead launch fully, this means that the full game will be completed sooner than expected but also that the imminent release of an Early Access version will not.

It's a tough decision to make because we know that a lot of people were looking forward to playing the Early Access version real soon and we feel we've already caused trouble for some people by pushing this release date back once before.

[b]So to make up for this we will be opening up another round of beta testing[/b] soon, this will also help us stress test the back-end services (which was why we chose Early Access in the first place).

We will post a Steam Announcement once registration for the beta test becomes available but if you want to get ahead of that and pre-register your interest please join our Discord and let us know and we'll make sure you're at the front of the queue!

Many thanks

Andy and Amy

notes.title: Short Delay for Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/023838bda2cac19ddcdecb4ca112d6cfbdc0cab4.png[/img]

Hello everyone and thank you for your interest in SUPER 56!

This is a quick update to let you know that the game will be delayed by a short while due to an unforeseen event.

As a result we'll be adding language support to the initial Early Access release!

At the moment we can't give you a new release date or confirmation of the languages but don't worry as we'll be able to do that very soon.

Thank you for your patience and we hope you have a SUPER day!

- Andy and Amy
